answer_2.quote: We use Attack Success Rate (ASR) to measure attack effectiveness, defined as: ASR DoS = N DoS /N Attempts (4) where N Ret represent the number of queries retrieving the Manipulator Tool, N Call represent the number of queries calling the Manipulator Tool, N PT , N DoS , and N UTC are the number of successful attacks for privacy theft, denial-of-service, and unscheduled tool-calling, and N Attempts is the number of callings for each attack type.
